changes.1: Surface-aware immutable commitment, burial prevention and bounded surface panel proposals.
changes.2: Shared scoring before/after refinement, joint face trimming, preserved seed/refined/grown alternatives and direct residual fallback.
changes.3: Support-plane orientations and eigengap-aware PCA for symmetric shapes.
changes.4: Local distinct-point scales, stable radius inclusion and anisotropic XYZ footprints.
changes.5: Resolution-independent tolerance, stable cell quantization, adaptive area bounds and component gates.
changes.6: Anisotropic covariance footprints and depth-compatible interpolation.
changes.7: Independent analytic corpus and strict failing quality contracts in CI.
changes.8: Bounded spatial/projection/support reuse and exact local surface classification updates.
changes.9: Guarded, streamed and tiled candidate workspaces at unchanged resolution.
changes.10: Stage compatibility, retained-population identity, cached support prefix and rebake-only CLI.
changes.11: Optional diagnostics and removal of unused attachment, duplicate state and legacy grid code.
changes.12: Consistent source-point sRGB display for linear inputs.

limitations: Immutable greedy selection and finite proposal budgets do not guarantee every requested target or an optimal number of boxes.
Failed quality contracts are retained above; strict corpus failures are not reported as successful validation.
The reconstruction envelope remains dense; candidate workspace guards are not an OS limit on total resident memory.
Adaptive area bounds can remain inconclusive near a target or when work/depth/ambiguous-area limits are reached.
Source support and color-layer tests do not infer camera visibility or prove the topology of unobserved geometry.
